newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Where EU members stand on EMU.
newsitem.headline: Where EU members stand on EMU.

text.p: Sweden's ruling Social Democrats announced they do not want to join the first wave of Europe's Economic and Monetary Union in 1999, but left the door open to adopting the common currency at a later stage.

Here is where the 15 European Union countries stand when it comes to their planned participation in economic and monetary union (EMU) and whether they are now in the bloc's exchange rate mechanism (ERM).

Belgium member aims to be in first wave
